svg.font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
svg.text: Memory against the cap, all nine days
anonymous memory, % of the container cap, 10-minute peaks · shaded = building, replaying · red tick = OOM kill
Dimmed: before that node's counted migration (earlier attempts). Gaps are nodes down: the two 16 GiB geths for 3 h 40 m after the fork, geth-2 for 26 h. The
geths' share drops after the fork because they restarted on 64 GiB caps.
